incident.sentenceEn: However, the spokesman of the supermarket said the store had taken strong action in response to incidents .
incident.translationZh: 然而，该超市的发言人表示，门店已针对这些事件采取了强硬措施。
incident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

incident.sentenceEn: What did the spokesperson say about the incident ?
incident.translationZh: 发言人就该事件发表了什么看法？

incident.sentenceEn: It is suffering a great deal from the incident .
incident.translationZh: 这只狗因这次事件而备受煎熬。

ingredient.sentenceEn: If you've ever looked at the ingredients list while grocery shopping, chances are you've seen the term "natural flavors".
ingredient.translationZh: 如果你曾在购物时查看食品成分表，很可能见过“天然香料”这个术语。
ingredient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ingredient.sentenceEn: My advice is that you not pay attention to the number of steps and ingredients , because they can be deceiving.
ingredient.translationZh: 我的建议是，不要在意步骤和食材的数量，因为这些可能具有欺骗性。

ingredient.sentenceEn: It's not because fresh ingredients are hard to come by.
ingredient.translationZh: 这并非因为难以获得新鲜食材。

ingredient.sentenceEn: And to save money and still eat well you don't need local, organic ingredients ; all you need is real food.
ingredient.translationZh: 要想省钱又吃得健康，你并不需要本地的有机食材；你只需要真正的食物。

ingredient.sentenceEn: The microwave and fast-food chains were the biggest catalysts(催化剂), but the big food companies—which want to sell anything except the raw ingredients that go into cooking—made the home cook an endangered species.
ingredient.translationZh: 微波炉和快餐连锁店是最大的催化剂，但大型食品公司——它们想销售除烹饪原料以外的任何东西——使家庭烹饪者变成了濒危物种。

ingredient.sentenceEn: Carême's knowledge of art and architecture helped him create extraordinary desserts out of ordinary ingredients .
ingredient.translationZh: 卡雷姆在艺术和建筑方面的知识帮助他用普通食材创作出非凡的甜点。

injury.sentenceEn: They probably had short lives, and their remains show evidence of severe injuries .
injury.translationZh: 他们的寿命可能很短，而他们的遗骸显示出曾遭受严重伤害的证据。
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

injury.sentenceEn: No injuries were reported in connection with the fire.
injury.translationZh: 目前没有接到与火灾相关的人员伤亡报告。
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

injury.sentenceEn: No injuries were reported on the plane, and the flight took off once again 7.5 hours after the first attempt.
injury.translationZh: 机上无人受伤，航班在首次尝试起飞7.5小时后再次起飞。
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

injury.sentenceEn: It was then taken to an examining room for evaluation of any injuries .
injury.translationZh: 随后，它被带到检查室以评估是否有任何损伤。
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

injury.sentenceEn: Thankfully, none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury .
injury.translationZh: 值得庆幸的是，这些事故均未造成严重伤害。
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

injury.sentenceEn: The army officers were examined for injuries .
injury.translationZh: 军官们接受了伤情检查。

intelligent.sentenceEn: Studies have shown that people who appear to be wealthy tend to be considered more intelligent , disciplined, and competent than those who do not.
intelligent.translationZh: 研究表明，与非富裕人群相比，看起来富裕的人往往被认为更聪明、更自律且更有能力。
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

intelligent.sentenceEn: New research by Horn and MIT postdoctoral associate Liang Wang, published in the journal IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, shows how bilateral control can fight the problem.
intelligent.translationZh: 霍恩与麻省理工学院博士后研究员王亮发表在《IEEE智能交通系统汇刊》上的最新研究，展示了双边控制如何解决这一问题。

intelligent.sentenceEn: The findings show: In principle, most people view it more favorably when workers are replaced by other people than by robots or intelligent software.
intelligent.translationZh: 研究结果表明：原则上，大多数人更倾向于接受工人被其他人取代，而非被机器人或智能软件取代。
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

intelligent.sentenceEn: After all, intelligent people earn more money, accumulate more wealth, and even live longer.
intelligent.translationZh: 毕竟，聪明人能赚更多钱，积累更多财富，甚至更长寿。
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

intelligent.sentenceEn: What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots?
intelligent.translationZh: 是什么导致了聪明人逻辑盲点的存在？

intelligent.sentenceEn: They are more intelligent than many of us.
intelligent.translationZh: 它们比我们许多人都更聪明。

immune.sentenceEn: This is evidence that our immune system really doesn't function so well when we age.
immune.translationZh: 这表明，随着年龄增长，我们的免疫系统功能确实会下降。
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

immune.sentenceEn: My research focus is on what happens to our immune system as we age.
immune.translationZh: 我的研究重点是随着年龄增长，我们的免疫系统会发生什么变化。
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

immune.sentenceEn: So the job of the immune system is to fight infections.
immune.translationZh: 免疫系统的功能是对抗感染。
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

immune.sentenceEn: For example, 10 bacteria or less of an especially deadly strain of bacteria can cause severe illness and death in people with compromised immune systems.
immune.translationZh: 例如，对于免疫系统受损的人来说，仅10个或更少的某种极具致命性的细菌菌株就可能导致严重疾病甚至死亡。

immune.sentenceEn: "When people are sleep-deprived, there are higher levels of stress hormones in their bodies, which can decrease immune function," says Doctor Felice of Northwestern University in Chicago.
immune.translationZh: 芝加哥西北大学的费利斯医生说：“当人们睡眠不足时，体内的应激激素水平会升高，这可能会降低免疫功能。”
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

immune.sentenceEn: Automatic driving systems are by no means immune to errors.
immune.translationZh: 自动驾驶系统绝非不会出错。

immediate.sentenceEn: While those visions of our future selves can be inspiring, when it comes to actually doing the day-to-day work, it may be more effective to reframe activities in terms of their immediate , or at least very near-term, rewards.
immediate.translationZh: 虽然对未来自我的憧憬能给人启发，但在实际进行日常工作时，将活动重新定义为能带来即时或至少近期回报的事情，可能会更有效。

immediate.sentenceEn: We get to enjoy the very concrete, immediate benefits of our actions while someone else (namely, our future selves) suffers the hypothetical(假设的), far-off consequences.
immediate.translationZh: 我们得以享受自己行为带来的非常具体、立竿见影的好处，而让别人（即未来的自己）承受那些假设性的、遥远的后果。

immediate.sentenceEn: Instead of fighting your present self's need for immediate rewards, why not use it to your advantage?
immediate.translationZh: 与其抗拒当下的自己对即时回报的需求，何不将其为你所用呢？

immediate.sentenceEn: At least 31 villages in Alaska face " immediate threats" due to climate change, the Government Accountability Office reported in 2009.
immediate.translationZh: 美国政府问责局2009年的报告显示，阿拉斯加至少有31个村庄因气候变化面临“直接威胁”。
immediate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

immediate.sentenceEn: Our brains are genetically determined to satisfy immediate desires.
immediate.translationZh: 我们的大脑在基因上就被设定为要满足即时欲望。

immediate.sentenceEn: It promises immediate rather than future benefits.
immediate.translationZh: 它承诺的是眼前利益，而非长远利益。

increased.sentenceEn: In 2013, researchers analysed the health data of 100,000 people collected between 1986 and 2009 and found that fruit juice consumption was linked with increased risk of type 2 diabetes.
increased.translationZh: 2013年，研究人员分析了1986年至2009年间收集的10万人健康数据，发现饮用果汁与2型糖尿病风险增加有关联。

increased.sentenceEn: A new study has cast doubt on historic research suggesting that the season or month of someone's birth is associated with an increased risk of certain mental health conditions.
increased.translationZh: 一项新研究对历史研究提出了质疑，这些历史研究表明一个人的出生季节或月份与某些心理健康疾病风险增加有关联。
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

increased.sentenceEn: If the very rich—the workers who have reaped above-average gains from the increased productivity since Keynes's time—can afford to work less, why do they continue to work so much?
increased.translationZh: 如果那些超级富豪——即自凯恩斯时代以来从生产力提升中获得了高于平均水平收益的劳动者——有能力减少工作量，那他们为什么还要继续拼命工作呢？

increased.sentenceEn: In a new paper, Friedman tries to figure out why that increased productivity has not translated into increased leisure time.
increased.translationZh: 在一篇新论文中，弗里德曼试图弄明白为什么生产力的提高并没有转化为更多的闲暇时间。

increased.sentenceEn: It can lead to increased innovation and greater trust on teams.
increased.translationZh: 这有助于增强团队的创新能力并增进团队信任。
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

increased.sentenceEn: Their increased comfort levels have boosted their sales.
increased.translationZh: 他们舒适度的提升促进了销量增长。

intervention.sentenceEn: In contrast, the new intervention cleverly exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy, and the value they place on social justice.
intervention.translationZh: 相比之下，这项新干预措施巧妙地利用了青少年反叛、自主的天性，以及他们对社会正义的重视。
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

intervention.sentenceEn: The researchers argued that previous interventions have probably been unsuccessful because of a major flaw: they focused on a future, healthier you and assumed that this would be enough motivation for teenagers.
intervention.translationZh: 研究人员认为，之前的干预措施之所以未能奏效，是因为存在一个重大缺陷：这些措施侧重于塑造一个更健康的未来自我，并假设这对青少年来说已经具备了足够的动力。
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

intervention.sentenceEn: Interventions (干预) to help reduce junk food consumption are especially important for children and teenagers.
intervention.translationZh: 旨在减少垃圾食品摄入的干预措施对儿童和青少年尤为重要。
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

intervention.sentenceEn: Importantly, there were also some promising effects of the new intervention on actual behavior.
intervention.translationZh: 更重要的是，这项新干预措施对实际行为也产生了一些积极的影响。
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

intervention.sentenceEn: In what way is the new intervention innovative?
intervention.translationZh: 这项新的干预措施在哪些方面具有创新性？

intervention.sentenceEn: An effective intervention has to be found to persuade teenagers to switch to a healthier lifestyle.
intervention.translationZh: 必须找到一种有效的干预手段，以说服青少年转而采取更健康的生活方式。

involved.sentenceEn: "Most large animals that eat meat live in increasingly fragmented landscapes," said Sillero, who was not involved in the research.
involved.translationZh: “大多数大型食肉动物生活在日益碎片化的环境中，”西莱罗说，他并未参与这项研究。
involved.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

involved.sentenceEn: But for volunteering to benefit employees and the workplace, the entire organization needs to be involved .
involved.translationZh: 但要让志愿服务真正惠及员工和工作场所，就需要整个组织的参与。
involved.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

involved.sentenceEn: Mr. Fong has been involved in the organization since he was 15 and began teaching lion dancing three years ago.
involved.translationZh: 方先生从15岁起就参与该组织，三年前开始教授舞狮技艺。

involved.sentenceEn: "When people book their holidays they get so emotionally involved , and when they find that villa at a good price with availability in peak season, they are an easy target," says Cooper.
involved.translationZh: 库珀说：“人们预订假期时往往情感投入很深，当他们发现一栋价格优惠且在旺季有空房的别墅时，就很容易成为诈骗目标。”

involved.sentenceEn: "We deny our children's bids to help until they are 6 or 7 years old," Lancy says, "when many have lost the desire to help and then try to motivate them with payment. The solution to this problem is not to try to use money as an incentive to do housework, but to get children involved in housework much earlier, when they actually want to do it."
involved.translationZh: 兰西说："我们一直拒绝孩子帮忙的请求，直到他们长到六七岁。而这时，许多孩子已经失去了帮忙的意愿，我们却转而尝试用金钱来激励他们。解决这个问题的办法不是试图用金钱作为做家务的奖励，而是在孩子真正愿意帮忙的更早阶段就让他们参与家务。"
involved.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

involved.sentenceEn: Avoid getting involved in conflicts with others.
involved.translationZh: 避免卷入与他人的冲突。

imitate.sentenceEn: Perhaps they made the sound of wind to comment on the weather or imitated the sound of a bird to tell a friend that there was a bird nearby.
imitate.translationZh: 或许他们会发出风声来评论天气，或者模仿鸟叫来告诉朋友附近有鸟。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

imitate.sentenceEn: The first theory is that language started with people making different sounds, mostly imitating the things around them, like animal calls, nature sounds, and the sounds of tools.
imitate.translationZh: 第一种理论认为，语言起源于人们发出的各种声音，主要是模仿周围的事物，比如动物的叫声、自然界的声音以及工具发出的声响。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

imitate.sentenceEn: The other main theory, which is more recent, is that people started off by gesturing—pointing at things with their hands and imitating actions using their bodies.
imitate.translationZh: 另一个较新的主要理论是，人类最初是通过手势交流——用手指向物体，并通过身体模仿动作。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

imitate.sentenceEn: Newer varieties imitate the look, flavor, and texture of meat.
imitate.translationZh: 较新的品种模仿肉类的外观、风味和质地。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

imitate.sentenceEn: Through this lens, he shows us that the first laws passed in the 1200s to ensure that only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments reflected the rise of the middle class, who were now able to imitate some of these fashions.
imitate.translationZh: 透过这一视角，他向我们展示，13世纪通过的首批法律规定只有贵族才能穿着特定面料、颜色和饰品，这实际上反映了中产阶级的崛起——他们当时已能够模仿部分此类时尚。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

imitate.sentenceEn: Super realistic masks are made from flexible materials such as silicone and are designed to imitate real human face—down to every last detail.
imitate.translationZh: 超写实面具由硅胶等柔性材料制成，旨在模仿真人面部——精确到每一个细节。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

intend.sentenceEn: The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to "U" shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior and reduce distraction from the teacher.
intend.translationZh: 传统上，采用排状排布及其向“U”型布局的微调，旨在最大程度地提高学生的专注度，并减少对教师教学的干扰。
intend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

intend.sentenceEn: It's a clear departure from the intended plan toward the intended goal.
intend.translationZh: 这明显偏离了实现既定目标的原定计划。
intend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

intend.sentenceEn: Researchers at the University of California scanned the brains of 42 classmates while they watched videos intended to provoke varying responses.
intend.translationZh: 加州大学的研究人员对42名同学的大脑进行了扫描，同时让他们观看旨在引发不同反应的视频。
intend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

intend.sentenceEn: Over 70% of male educators who said they intended to stay in the early education workforce noted an increased salary was a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term.
intend.translationZh: 在表示打算继续留在幼儿教育领域的男性教育工作者中，超过70%的人指出，薪资提高是促使他们长期从事这一职业的主要因素。
intend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

intend.sentenceEn: Chase Carey intends to make connections easier between the audience and the Formula One racers.
intend.translationZh: 蔡斯·凯里打算让观众与一级方程式赛车手之间更容易建立联系。

intend.sentenceEn: They were intended to share personal attitudes and relationships.
intend.translationZh: 这些活动本意是分享个人态度和人际关系。

implement.sentenceEn: The decision wasn't made lightly, but some recent events pushed them to implement this new policy.
implement.translationZh: 这个决定并非草率做出，但最近发生的一些事情促使他们实施了这项新政策。
implement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

implement.sentenceEn: They said it has the right to implement any rules it wants.
implement.translationZh: 他们表示，其有权实施任何想要的规则。
implement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

implement.sentenceEn: And finally, they implemented changes, like asking their supervisor for greater flexibility, or deciding not to take on every project that comes their way.
implement.translationZh: 最后，他们实施了一些改变，比如向主管要求更大的灵活性，或者决定不承接所有找上门来的项目。

implement.sentenceEn: The traditional school year, with three months of vacation every summer, was first implemented when America was an agricultural society and the summer months were needed for farm work.
implement.translationZh: 美国传统学年制度每年夏季有三个月假期，这种制度最初实施时，美国还是农业社会，夏季的几个月需要孩子们从事农活。
implement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

implement.sentenceEn: What should business leaders do before implementing new IT initiatives?
implement.translationZh: 企业领导者在实施新的信息技术计划之前应该做什么？

implement.sentenceEn: It has implemented a decision to expand business.
implement.translationZh: 它已落实扩大业务规模的决定。

indicator.sentenceEn: The most major indicator of classical music's importance in society today is the fact that much of the popular music that is currently being produced uses similar beats, harmonies, and melodies(旋律) as those that were used in some of classical music's best works.
indicator.translationZh: 古典音乐在当今社会重要性的最主要指标是，当前制作的许多流行音乐使用的节拍、和声与旋律，与一些古典音乐杰作中使用的相似。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

indicator.sentenceEn: Even so, it can be difficult for those who do not study music theory to see this as an indicator , since it is subtle and just shows the impact symphonic(交响乐的) orchestras have had on society's taste in music.
indicator.translationZh: 即便如此，对于不学习音乐理论的人来说，很难将其视为一种标志，因为这种影响十分微妙，它只是体现了交响乐团对社会音乐品味所产生的影响。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

indicator.sentenceEn: Granted, you will not typically see today's teenagers lending their ears to Bach anytime soon, but there are some major indicators that both opera and classical music are now still quite alive.
indicator.translationZh: 诚然，你不太可能看到如今的青少年很快就迷上巴赫，但有一些重要迹象表明，歌剧和古典音乐至今仍然颇具生命力。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

indicator.sentenceEn: One recent study published in the journal PLOS ONE, for example, found that the strength of a person's social circle was a better indicator of self-reported stress, happiness and well-being levels than fitness tracker data on physical activity, heart rate and sleep.
indicator.translationZh: 例如，近期发表在《公共科学图书馆·综合》(PLOS ONE)期刊上的一项研究发现，一个人的社交圈强度比健身追踪器记录的身体活动、心率和睡眠数据更能反映其自我报告的压力、幸福感和健康水平。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

indicator.sentenceEn: This can be a big indicator of what sort of atmosphere the company is trying to cultivate.
indicator.translationZh: 这能很好地表明公司想要营造什么样的氛围。

indicator.sentenceEn: It can be seen as an indicator of refinement on classical music.
indicator.translationZh: 它可以被视为古典音乐精致化的一个标志。

inspiration.sentenceEn: Furthermore, active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm.
inspiration.translationZh: 此外，主动启发才能带来长久的激情与热忱。
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

inspiration.sentenceEn: Instead, it is through the process of active inspiration —the act of creating things, applying new ideas to our goals, and making mistakes that we discover who we are and what is important to us.
inspiration.translationZh: 相反，正是通过主动启发的过程——即创造事物、将新想法应用于我们的目标、以及从错误中学习——我们才能发现真实的自我和对我们真正重要的事物。
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

inspiration.sentenceEn: The problem is that consuming the success and ideas of others is passive inspiration .
inspiration.translationZh: 问题在于，一味吸收他人的成功经验和想法属于被动式启发。
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

index.sentenceEn: Researchers have shown that body mass index is related to wages and income.
index.translationZh: 研究人员已证实，体重指数与薪资收入相关。

index.sentenceEn: She checked the index and turned over to a page about early Chinese immigrants in California.
index.translationZh: 她查阅了索引，然后翻到关于早期加州中国移民的那一页。

index.sentenceEn: The Human Development Index —a measure of life expectancy, education and per capita(人均的) income—gives East San Jose a score of 4.85 out of 10, while nearby Cupertino, where Apple's headquarters sits, receives a 9.26.
index.translationZh: 人类发展指数（一项衡量预期寿命、教育程度和人均收入的指标）给东圣何塞打出的分数是4.85分（总分10分），而苹果公司总部所在地——邻近的库比蒂诺则获得9.26分。

index.sentenceEn: In one US study that analysed the health data of 50,000 people over seven years, researchers found that those who made breakfast the largest meal of the day were more likely to have a lower body mass index (BMI) than those who ate a large lunch or dinner.
index.translationZh: 在美国一项对5万人长达七年的健康数据分析研究中，研究人员发现，将早餐作为一天中最丰盛一餐的人，其身体质量指数(BMI)往往低于那些午餐或晚餐吃得丰盛的人。

index.sentenceEn: Despite having a brain no bigger than the tip of your index finger, pigeons have a very impressive visual memory.
index.translationZh: 尽管鸽子的大脑还没有食指指尖那么大，但它们却拥有令人惊叹的视觉记忆力。
index.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

index.sentenceEn: Why are Record and Austin especially worried about the low body mass index of models?
index.translationZh: 为什么雷科德和奥斯汀对模特的低体重指数尤其担忧？

integrate.sentenceEn: "The realizations I had in that process helped me gain insights and ultimately got me ready to integrate self-care into my daily life," she said.
integrate.translationZh: 她说：“在这个过程中获得的感悟帮助我深入思考，最终让我准备好将自我关怀融入日常生活。”

integrate.sentenceEn: This shows that while our bodies are at rest, our brains are drawing what's important from the information and events we've recently encountered, then integrating that data into the vast store of what we already know.
integrate.translationZh: 这表明，当我们的身体处于休息状态时，大脑正在从我们最近遇到的信息和事件中提取重要内容，然后将这些信息整合到我们已有的庞大知识储备中。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

integrate.sentenceEn: It can be seen from the cheapest budget airlines to the world's largest carriers: Airlines across the globe integrate various shades of blue in their cabin seats, and it is no coincidence.
integrate.translationZh: 从最便宜的廉价航空公司到全球最大的航空承运人，这一现象随处可见：世界各地的航空公司都在其客舱座椅中融入了深浅不一的蓝色，这绝非偶然。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

integrate.sentenceEn: What seems to be missing in school is how these subjects integrate , how they fit together in any meaningful way.
integrate.translationZh: 学校教育中似乎缺失的是各学科如何整合，如何以有意义的方式相互联系。

integrate.sentenceEn: Almost all companies recognize the importance of innovation today, but not many are able to integrate innovation into their business.
integrate.translationZh: 如今，几乎所有企业都认识到创新的重要性，但能够将创新融入自身业务的却并不多。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

integrate.sentenceEn: It should be integrated into high school education.
integrate.translationZh: 它应该被整合到高中教育中。

intention.sentenceEn: He says: "When we practice something, we are involved in the deliberate repetition of a process with the intention of reaching a specific goal."
intention.translationZh: 他说：“当我们练习某件事时，我们是在有意识地重复一个过程，目的是达到特定的目标。”

intention.sentenceEn: Here the words "deliberate" and " intention " are key, because they define the difference between actively practicing something and passively learning it.
intention.translationZh: 在这里，“刻意”和“意图”这两个词是关键，因为它们界定了主动练习与被动学习之间的区别。

intention.sentenceEn: Nevertheless, while the woman's intention was to feed birds, it is clear that rats were also benefiting.
intention.translationZh: 然而，尽管该女子的初衷是喂鸟，但显然老鼠也从中获益。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

intention.sentenceEn: They can create social media groups in which employees will be more likely to collaborate and less likely to share withdrawal intentions or discussions about external job opportunities.
intention.translationZh: 他们可以创建社交媒体群组，在这些群组中，员工更有可能进行协作，而不太可能表达离职意向或讨论外部工作机会。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

intention.sentenceEn: Managers can also use social media to directly reduce turnover(跳槽) intentions , by recognizing employees' accomplishments and giving visibility to employees' success stories.
intention.translationZh: 管理者还可以利用社交媒体直接降低员工的跳槽意向，具体做法包括认可员工的成就，并让员工的成功故事获得更多关注。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

intention.sentenceEn: It may lead to misunderstanding despite good intentions .
intention.translationZh: 即便出于善意，它也可能导致误解。

interfere.sentenceEn: My colleagues and I wondered whether midazolam, the most common sedative(镇静剂) used in surgical procedures worldwide, might interfere with the internal clock that protects the heart at night.

interfere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

interfere.sentenceEn: But if their hobby is quite different from their career, it may not interfere in the same way but instead help them develop other knowledge and skills that can boost their confidence at work.
interfere.translationZh: 但如果他们的爱好与职业截然不同，可能就不会以同样的方式产生干扰，反而有助于他们发展其他知识和技能，从而增强工作自信心。

interfere.sentenceEn: The second group, however, was told that the phones would interfere with the equipment in the experiment, and would need to be moved away from the testing area.
interfere.translationZh: 然而，第二组学生被告知他们的手机会干扰实验设备，需要将手机移至测试区域之外。

interfere.sentenceEn: Some, like carpenter ants, can undermine a home's structure, while others interfere with electrical units.
interfere.translationZh: 例如，像木匠蚁这类蚂蚁会破坏房屋结构，而其他种类的蚂蚁则会干扰电器设备。

interfere.sentenceEn: Interfering with a wireless security system is similar to interfering with a conversation.
interfere.translationZh: 干扰无线安全系统类似于干扰对话。

interfere.sentenceEn: Politics interferes with serious scientific debate.
interfere.translationZh: 政治干预严肃的科学辩论。

improved.sentenceEn: Most people set goals to achieve delayed, long-term benefits, such as career advancement, debt repayment, or improved health.

improved.sentenceEn: Greater Internet access correlates directly with improved health care, education and economic development.
improved.translationZh: 互联网接入的普及程度与医疗保健、教育和经济发展的改善直接相关。

improved.sentenceEn: This would imply that the participants in the current study may have felt better due to improved diet.
improved.translationZh: 这意味着本研究的参与者可能因饮食改善而感觉更好。

improved.sentenceEn: They also reported improved mental health and subjective vitality immediately after the program.
improved.translationZh: 他们还报告说，在课程结束后，心理健康状况和主观活力立即得到了改善。

improved.sentenceEn: They did not become popular until the emergence of improved batteries.
improved.translationZh: 直到性能更优良的电池出现后，电动自行车才开始流行起来。

inability.sentenceEn: Yes, my advanced age must factor into the equation(等式), in part because of my inability to access the information as quickly.
inability.translationZh: 是的，我的年长肯定是其中一个因素，部分原因是我无法快速获取信息。

incredible.sentenceEn: Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success.

incredible.sentenceEn: "Lion dancing started 2,000 years ago—that's incredible ," she said.
incredible.translationZh: 她说：“舞狮起源于两千年前——这太不可思议了。”

incredible.sentenceEn: You can find incredible videos, articles and news stories about the success of others.
incredible.translationZh: 你能找到关于他人成功的精彩视频、文章和新闻故事。

incredible.sentenceEn: Regardless of their genetic makeup, infants have to learn an incredible amount of information in a short time, and curiosity is one of the tools humans have found to accomplish that gigantic task.
incredible.translationZh: 无论基因构成如何，婴儿都必须在短时间内学习海量信息，而好奇心正是人类为完成这一艰巨任务所发现的工具之一。

informal.translationZh: 任何形式的“培训”，即便是花费不多且非正式的培训，都有助于打消他们对雇佣 45 岁以上人员的顾虑。

informal.sentenceEn: Those who had successfully changed careers after 45 told Generation that education and training had been a big help — and that included in-person, on-the-job training, " informal learning," and online courses — with or without certification.
informal.translationZh: 那些在45岁以后成功转行的人告诉Generation组织，教育和培训起到了很大帮助——这包括面授培训、在职培训、“非正式学习”以及在线课程，无论是否获得认证。

informal.sentenceEn: This is intentional as the informal tone of the assistant helps create an emotional attachment.
informal.translationZh: 这是有意为之的，因为语音助手的非正式语气有助于建立情感联系。

informal.sentenceEn: Friends and acquaintances can comfortably occupy this zone, especially during informal conversations, but strangers are forbidden.
informal.translationZh: 朋友和熟人可以自在地处于这个空间内，尤其是在非正式交谈时，但陌生人则不被允许。
informal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

informal.sentenceEn: Evil is typically referred to when there is deviance from social norms: formal deviance is the violation of laws, like theft, murder, and attacks, while informal deviance involves violations of social norms, like lying.
informal.translationZh: 当行为偏离社会规范时，我们通常会称之为邪恶：形式违规是指违反法律，如盗窃、谋杀和袭击；而非形式违规则涉及违反社会规范，如说谎。

informal.sentenceEn: Adopt an informal style of writing.

interpersonal.sentenceEn: For instance, in a follow-up study conducted with a sample of 300 students, the researchers manipulated power dynamics in an interpersonal setting to see if this would influence communicative abstraction.

interpersonal.sentenceEn: While it may sound safe to avoid all physical contact so as not to offend anyone, the lack of touching might imply cold attitudes or indifference in interpersonal relationships.
interpersonal.translationZh: 虽然避免所有身体接触以免冒犯他人听起来似乎是稳妥之举，但缺乏接触可能会在人际关系中显得态度冷淡或漠不关心。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: There are also rules dealing with interpersonal relationships: Be a responsible human being and do not do evil things to others.
interpersonal.translationZh: 还有一些规则涉及人际关系：要做一个负责任的人，不要对他人行恶。

interpersonal.sentenceEn: How can the self-disclosure approach succeed in increasing interpersonal closeness?
interpersonal.translationZh: 表露自我的方法如何成功增进人际亲密感？

interpersonal.sentenceEn: They tend to be more open in interpersonal relationships.
interpersonal.translationZh: 他们在人际关系中往往更为开放。

irregular.sentenceEn: Curious if the left hemispheres were indeed remaining awake to process information detected in the surrounding environment, Dr. Sasaki re-ran the experiment while presenting the sleeping participants with a mix of regularly timed beeps(蜂鸣声) of the same tone and irregular beeps of a different tone during the night.
irregular.translationZh: 佐佐木博士好奇左脑半球是否确实保持清醒以处理周围环境中检测到的信息，于是她重新进行了实验。在夜间，她向熟睡的参与者播放由定时响起的相同音调蜂鸣声和不定时响起的不同音调蜂鸣声混合而成的声音。
irregular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

irregular.sentenceEn: She worked out that, if the left hemisphere was staying alert to keep guard in a strange environment, then it would react to the irregular beeps by stirring people from sleep and would ignore the regularly timed ones.
irregular.translationZh: 她推断，如果左脑半球在陌生环境中保持警觉以起到警戒作用，那么它应该会对这种不规则的蜂鸣声做出反应，将人从睡梦中唤醒，而对那些定时出现的蜂鸣声则会忽略。
irregular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

irregular.sentenceEn: We have John standing by the time clock, and he swears he saw nothing irregular .
irregular.translationZh: 我们安排了约翰在打卡机旁值班，他发誓说没看到任何异常情况。
irregular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

irregular.sentenceEn: They are frequently scheduled at irregular times.
irregular.translationZh: 它们的安排时间往往很不方便。
